setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (2 reviews): Recording of this song is remarkable, with Phil's bass playing especially strong; Described as a particularly tragic version, a highlight for the reviewer [7][12]
- **Turn on Your Lovelight** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Lovelight as the show's standout, worth top marks by itself; About fifteen minutes long, with Pigpen and Jerry interacting intensely; an excellent version [4][14]
- **Clementine** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best Clementine they can recall [11]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Short version played by Jerry at a pace too fast for longer versions; feels all Jerry [12]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): The Eleven into Lovelight is the pairing that appeared on Live Dead [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Clementine**: rare: 7 archived performances [15]
- **William Tell**: rare: 9 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd69-01-26.sbd.kaplan.2246.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 79 min; rated 4.48/5 by 25 [1]. Said about its sound: Lacks the high-end distortion or crunchiness heard on other recordings from this period; The mix swings wildly for a couple of minutes before settling down; Sound quality problems at the start of the recording [3][4][5][11][12][14]
- **gd1969-01-26.sbd.miller.109642.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 79 min; rated 4.5/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Mix problems at the start of the show, and a reel flip in Dark Star [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer first burned this show as a child, hearing Jerry tear up on a Gibson guitar [8]
- Also on the bill were Sons of Champlin and Initial Shock [2]
- Cleaner than other shows of the era, which have a crunchier, distorted top end [3]
- Reviewer prefers the earlier Clementines to the one played here [5]
- Reviewer has heard other shows from this period with more power [6]
- Reviewer rejects calling this peak Dead, since much great music still lay ahead [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-01-26.sbd.kaplan.2246.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard adjustments made on first Cryptical Envelopment; Dark Star has a splice at 8:12 [1]
- **gd1969-01-26.sbd.miller.109642.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Transfer made from DATs lent by Rob Eaton [2]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead poster for 1/24, 1/25, 1/26/69 Avalon Ballroom, San Francisco borrowed from www.deadlists.com](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3223348712/) [16]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3223348712/) [17]
